name: functions_round
title: Questions the observer can now settle in GSGasStation with RingoRef (save nvftest; plugin version 9): an essential actor knocked out (GetKnockedState, GetUnconscious, how long it stays down; script-function-coverage section 3.3), the karma for killing an NCRCF convict that attacks the player and one that does not (playtest list 5 item 22), laying a frag mine (IsPlayerActionActive's indices), a critical kill with a plasma rifle (IsInCriticalStage; section 3.3), and the Pip-Boy's MenuMode codes (section 3.3). The sessions run in one game load in this order; the Pip-Boy is last because a menu left open would hold the rest.

sessions.name: essential_ko
sessions.note: SetEssential on Ringo's base, then KillActor: an essential actor is knocked out instead [documented: GECK wiki KillActor/Essential]. GetKnockedState, GetUnconscious, Health and the AI procedure every 2 game loops for 0.5 game hours (60 s).

sessions.name: convict_aggressor
sessions.note: An NCRCF Powder Ganger (LvlNCRCFPowderGangerMelee) spawned 400 units in front and set on the player (god mode), killed by the player (KillActor player) about 10 s later; the player's karma (header) and the convict's own karma and alignment before and after.

sessions.name: convict_calm
sessions.note: The same convict spawned without being set on the player, killed by the player 4 s later (before it can attack of its own accord, if it would).

sessions.name: mines
sessions.note: Three frag mines equipped and the attack control tapped twice: which IsPlayerActionActive index a laid mine turns on, and the player's GetAnimAction.

sessions.name: crit_plasma
sessions.note: Ringo held (SetRestrained), at 10 Health, 150 units west of the player who faces him with a plasma rifle and Critical Chance 100; the attack control tapped three times. IsInCriticalStage for the four stages on every actor every game loop.

sessions.name: pipboy_menus
sessions.note: The Pip-Boy opened with its control (TapControl 14) and closed with it again 8 s later; MenuMode with no code and with the Pip-Boy pages' codes every 2 game loops. No close_menus hook (con_CloseAllMenus must not be used on the Pip-Boy [documented: GECK wiki]).
